ailab.title: AI LAB
ailab.intro: Here I don't tell you what I can do with AI: I let you try it. Each experiment tells you where it runs, how it's built and what I decided. Most of them run entirely in your browser.
ailab.plugins: I also build AI plugins for specific professions. For a lawyer, skills that organize case material, test hypotheses and draft documents. For a structural engineer, an assistant that reads his logs, helps with calculations and builds the estimate. The showcases below use made-up data only.
ailab.privacy: I don't store your audio or your text. They're processed in your browser and never leave it.
ailab.meta.description: AI experiments that run in your browser: try them, see how they work and read their code.

ailab.v1.title: Transcriber
ailab.v1.summary: Record or upload audio and get the text with timestamps. It uses the same kind of engine as the voice dictation tool I built to write in Spanish with English tech terms.
ailab.v1.privacy: Your audio is transcribed in your browser and never leaves your device.
ailab.v1.local: Everything happens on your device: the audio is transcribed in a worker in this browser and is never sent to any server.
ailab.v1.engine: Besides the model, the first time it loads the engine that runs it (ONNX Runtime Web, about 27 MB), served from this same site.

ailab.v2.title: Text → speech
ailab.v2.summary: Type some text and hear it with your browser's voices, in Spanish or English.
ailab.v2.privacy: The text is read with your browser's voices. If a voice is generated online, I warn you before using it.
ailab.v3.title: Listen to the posts
ailab.v3.summary: The same engine reads a blog post aloud: just the body, without the code blocks, in the page's language.
ailab.v3.privacy: The post is read with your browser's voices. If a voice is generated online, I warn you before using it.
ailab.v4.title: Navigate by voice
ailab.v4.summary: Tell the site where to go: "take me to the blog", "switch to light theme".
ailab.v4.privacy: Your voice becomes text in your browser, and only commands from the site's palette run.
ailab.v4.local: Your voice becomes text in this browser with Whisper tiny. The audio is never sent to any server, and only palette commands run.

ailab.a2.title: Anatomy of a plugin
ailab.a2.summary: This is how a Claude Code plugin is built: skills, commands, hooks and MCP servers. Tap each file to see what it's for, and build your own at the end.
ailab.a2.privacy: It doesn't download or send anything: it's a tour of the files of a sample plugin.
ailab.a3.title: Build your skill
ailab.a3.summary: Write the name, when to use it and its steps, and download a valid SKILL.md, built in your browser.
ailab.a3.privacy: What you write becomes a file in your browser and never leaves it.
ailab.a5.title: Glass-box search
ailab.a5.summary: Ask something about the blog, the projects or my career, and see the passages it found, with their score and their source.
ailab.a5.privacy: Your question is searched in your browser, over the site's index, and isn't sent anywhere.
ailab.r1.title: Saga simulator
ailab.r1.summary: Book a trip and take down a service in the middle of the payment. Watch the system undo what was already done, and why undoing a booking isn't the same as releasing a hold.
ailab.r1.privacy: It's a simulation in your browser: it doesn't use or store any of your data.
ailab.a4.title: Showcases: Despacho and Obra
ailab.a4.summary: Despacho turns a fictional case into facts with evidence and a timeline. Obra turns a sample log into quantities and an estimate in COP, with Python in your browser.
ailab.a4.privacy: Made-up data. Despacho doesn't download anything, and Obra calculates in your browser.
ailab.j1.title: Rally against the AI
ailab.j1.summary: Play against a rival that starts clumsy and learns live, game after game. Watch its brain light up with every decision.
ailab.j1.privacy: What the rival learns stays only in your browser, and you can delete it.
ailab.j2.title: Play against your clone
ailab.j2.summary: After a few rallies, the rival learns your style. Play against an AI that moves like you.
ailab.j2.privacy: Your moves train the clone in your browser and never leave it.
